title: ADR-21: Product search on OpenSearch
storage:
Status: Accepted · Date: 2026-02-03

Context

Catalog has 40M listings and needs Korean morphological analysis.

Decision

Buyer-facing product search runs on Amazon OpenSearch Service with the nori analyzer.

Alternatives considered

  • Algolia: rejected. Per-record pricing at 40M listings is several times our infra budget.
  • Typesense: rejected because nobody on the team has run it in production.

title: 2026-03-11 Payments guild — meeting notes
storage:
Attendees: Checkout, Finance

Discussion

  • EU sellers asked for local payment methods.

Decisions

  • Decision: all buyer payments are processed through Stripe only; we will not integrate a second payment processor such as Adyen or Braintree this year.

Action items

  • Enable SEPA and iDEAL in Stripe (Checkout team).

title: Seller payouts handbook
storage:
Why we hold funds

Most disputes are opened within a week of delivery.

Policy

Seller payouts are released only after the order is marked delivered and the 7-day return window has closed. Funds must never be paid out at the time of shipment.

title: Review integrity rules
storage:
Background

Regulators fined two marketplaces last year for suppressed reviews.

Rule

Buyer reviews are published only after automated moderation, and sellers must not edit, hide or delete buyer reviews.

Sellers may still post a public reply to a review.

title: ADR-24: Product images on S3 and CloudFront
storage:
Status: Accepted · Date: 2026-02-20

Decision

Product images are stored in S3 and resized and served through CloudFront with Lambda@Edge. We will not use Cloudinary or Imgix for image delivery.

title: ADR-12: Order events on RabbitMQ
storage:
Status: Superseded by ADR-31 · Date: 2025-06-01

Decision

Order lifecycle events are published to a RabbitMQ topic exchange.

title: ADR-31: Order events on Amazon EventBridge
storage:
Status: Accepted · Date: 2026-05-14 · Supersedes ADR-12

Decision

Order lifecycle events are published to an Amazon EventBridge event bus. RabbitMQ was rejected for new work because nobody owns the cluster.

title: 가격 변경 권한
storage:
배경

운영자가 판매자 몰래 가격을 바꿔 분쟁이 생겼다.

원칙

상품 가격은 판매자만 변경할 수 있으며, 운영자나 자동화 작업이 판매자 동의 없이 가격을 직접 수정해서는 안 된다.

예외: 부가세 표기 누락 같은 법적 표기 오류 수정은 허용한다.

title: Buyer privacy standard
storage:
Scope

Everything sellers can see or download.

Standard

Buyer email addresses and phone numbers must not be shared with sellers. Seller-buyer contact goes through the masked messaging relay.

title: ADR-27: Storefront on Next.js
storage:
Status: Accepted · Date: 2026-04-18

Decision

The buyer-facing storefront web app is built with Next.js. We decided not to use Remix or a custom SSR server.

Consequences

Internal seller-ops dashboards may use plain React with Vite.

title: Database change guidelines
storage:
Guidelines

Schema changes must be backward compatible (expand, then contract). A column is dropped or renamed only in a later release, after no deployed code reads it.
